article.title: Certain transfers to be void.
article.content:
330Certain transfers to be void.

Section 330  ·  Chapter XX  ·  Part III  ·  page 185 of the Act
Any transfer or assignment by a company of all its properties or assets to trustees for the benefit of all its creditors shall be void.
